svg.title: The 1998 intake, and where they are now
svg.desc: Two panels comparing a group photograph of a 1998 medical intake with a list of where the same people are working now.

g.text: two matches, two moves, one gone
The 1998 intake, and where they are now
Learner A has the photograph. Learner B has what each of them said they wanted.
Two of them got what they said. Which, and how can you tell?
